config.title: Pseudo-classes :hover :focus :active

intro.title: Pseudo-classes :hover :focus :active
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple interactive button that changes its appearance when a user interacts with it. You will learn the core concept of CSS pseudo-classes, which are special keywords that style an element based on its state. The main technologies involved are the :hover, :focus, and :active pseudo-classes to handle mouse hover, keyboard focus, and click interactions. By the end, you'll be able to create more dynamic and responsive web elements using these fundamental CSS selectors.
intro.usecase: Pseudo-classes like :hover, :focus, and :active are essential for creating intuitive, accessible user interfaces across modern web applications. In e-commerce sites, :hover reveals product details or color options on cards, while :focus guides users through checkout forms with clear visual feedback. Dashboard components use :active to indicate clicked buttons or toggled filters, and navigation menus rely on these states to show interactive affordances. Mastering these selectors allows developers to build polished, responsive interfaces that improve user experience and meet accessibility standards.

objectives: Apply the :hover pseudo-class to change element styles when a user's pointer moves over them
Implement the :focus pseudo-class to style form elements when they receive keyboard or mouse focus
Configure the :active pseudo-class to provide visual feedback during user interaction
Construct CSS rules that combine multiple pseudo-classes for complex interactive states
Manipulate element properties like color, background, and border using pseudo-class selectors
Integrate pseudo-class styles with existing CSS rules to enhance user interface feedback
Initialize interactive components with appropriate pseudo-class styling for accessibility and usability

steps.title: Create a CSS file and add a basic button style
steps.instruction: Create a CSS file and add a basic button style with padding, background color, and border.
steps.hint: Start by creating a CSS file (e.g., styles.css) and define a button selector with padding, background-color, and border properties.
steps.seedCode: /* Add a basic button style with padding, background color, and border */
steps.expectedOutcome: A CSS file is created with a button selector that includes padding, background-color, and border properties.
successCriteria: The CSS file contains a button selector with padding, background-color, and border properties defined.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure your button selector includes padding, background-color, and border properties.
steps.feedbackWrong: Please create a CSS file and add a button style with padding, background color, and border properties.

steps.title: Add the :hover pseudo-class to change button color on mouseover
steps.instruction: Add a :hover selector to the existing button style to change its background color when the mouse hovers over it.
steps.hint: After your existing button style, add a new selector that targets the button when hovered, like 'button:hover', and set a different background-color.
steps.expectedOutcome: The button's background color will change when you hover the mouse over it.
successCriteria: A :hover selector is added that changes the button's background color on mouseover.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've added a selector, but make sure it's specifically 'button:hover' and that it changes the background-color property.
steps.feedbackWrong: The :hover pseudo-class wasn't added correctly. Check that you're targeting 'button:hover' and setting a different background-color.

steps.title: Add the :focus pseudo-class to style focused elements
steps.instruction: Add a :focus selector for the button to change its outline and border when it receives keyboard focus.
steps.hint: Use the selector 'button:focus' and define styles like 'outline' and 'border' properties.
steps.expectedOutcome: The button will have a visible outline and border when focused via keyboard navigation.
successCriteria: A :focus selector for the button is added with outline and border styles.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You added a :focus selector, but make sure it targets the button and includes outline and border styles.
steps.feedbackWrong: The :focus pseudo-class for the button is missing or incorrect. Try adding 'button:focus' with outline and border styles.

steps.title: Add the :active pseudo-class to style clicked elements
steps.instruction: Add an :active pseudo-class selector for the button to change its background color to a darker shade when it is being clicked.
steps.hint: The :active pseudo-class applies styles while the element is being activated (e.g., mouse button held down). Use a darker color like #0056b3 for the background-color property.
steps.expectedOutcome: The button will have a darker background color while it is being clicked, providing visual feedback for user interaction.
successCriteria: An :active selector for the button is added with a background-color property set to a darker shade (e.g., #0056b3).
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You added an :active selector, but ensure it targets the button and changes the background-color to a darker shade.
steps.feedbackWrong: The :active pseudo-class for the button is missing or incorrect. Add a selector like 'button:active' with a background-color property.

steps.title: Create a link element with basic styling
steps.instruction: Add a CSS rule for an anchor link (<a>) with basic styling: set the color to #007bff, remove the default underline with text-decoration: none, and add padding of 10px.
steps.hint: Create a new selector for 'a' and define the properties color, text-decoration, and padding inside curly braces.
steps.expectedOutcome: A new CSS rule for anchor links is added with color, no underline, and padding.
successCriteria: The CSS includes a selector for 'a' with color: #007bff, text-decoration: none, and padding: 10px.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure your CSS rule includes all three required properties: color, text-decoration, and padding.
steps.feedbackWrong: It looks like the link styling is missing or incorrect. Please add a CSS rule for 'a' with the specified properties.

steps.title: Add :hover effect to the link
steps.instruction: Add a :hover pseudo-class selector for the link element to change its color to dark red (#b30000) and add a text-decoration underline when the mouse hovers over it.
steps.hint: Target the link element with a:hover, then set color and text-decoration properties inside the selector block.
steps.expectedOutcome: The link will change to dark red and become underlined when the mouse pointer hovers over it.
successCriteria: The CSS includes a:hover selector with color: #b30000 and text-decoration: underline.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure your a:hover selector includes both the color change to #b30000 and text-decoration: underline.
steps.feedbackWrong: The hover effect for the link is missing or incorrect. Please add a:hover selector with the specified properties.

steps.title: Add :focus effect to the link
steps.instruction: Add a :focus selector for the link to change its outline and background color when focused.
steps.hint: Use the :focus pseudo-class after the link selector. Inside, set outline and background-color properties.
steps.expectedOutcome: The link will have a visible outline and background color change when focused (e.g., by tab navigation).
successCriteria: A :focus selector for the link is added with outline and background-color properties.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You added a :focus selector, but it might be missing outline or background-color properties.
steps.feedbackWrong: The :focus effect for the link is not correctly implemented. Check the selector and properties.

steps.title: Create an input field with basic styling
steps.instruction: Add CSS rules to style an input field with basic properties including border, padding, and font properties.
steps.hint: Target the input element selector and define properties like border, padding, and font-size.
steps.expectedOutcome: The input field will have visible styling with border, padding, and font properties applied.
successCriteria: CSS rules for the input element include border, padding, and at least one font property.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've added some styling, but make sure to include border, padding, and font properties.
steps.feedbackWrong: The input field styling is missing or incomplete. Add CSS rules with border, padding, and font properties.

steps.title: Add :hover, :focus, and :active effects to the input field
steps.instruction: Add the :hover, :focus, and :active pseudo-class selectors to the input field to change its border color and background in different interactive states.
steps.hint: Create three separate selectors: input:hover, input:focus, and input:active. Use the border-color and background-color properties to style each state differently.
steps.expectedOutcome: The input field will have interactive visual feedback: it changes border color on hover, gets a distinct focus style, and shows a different background when clicked.
successCriteria: The CSS includes input:hover, input:focus, and input:active selectors with border-color and/or background-color properties defined.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've added some pseudo-class selectors, but make sure to include all three: :hover, :focus, and :active for the input field.
steps.feedbackWrong: The input field pseudo-class selectors are missing or incorrect. Please add input:hover, input:focus, and input:active selectors with appropriate styling.
